synth.notes:
Ring+beam move vertically by 6, carrying on-beam blocks and pushing blocks hit (push chain); cancelled if any block would leave the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6; a block at the tip (any tag) hooks every fully-on-beam block so the group follows the tip (step 87: three blocks shift with the tip).
Unhooked extend pushes blocks in the swept strip; blocked group -> beam moves alone. Tags: collected/next/revert per crane rules.
Hidden state: HUD bar counter n (non-click actions), bar=(n-1)//3, continuity-gated on frame with stateless fallback.
No extra hidden turn order/patrol needed; step-87 is explained by tag-agnostic hook drag.
